fixes: rate_tiers now ends tier 1 at its up_to inclusively and accepts the account offset of a meter, so tiers follow account positions.
standing_line prorates the standing charge month by month over each calendar month's own length instead of a flat 30 days.
share_allowance shares the allowance in equal parts over the account's energy lines, capped at each line's exact value, and re-shares the rest.
settle bases the commitment credit on the subtotal and derives the credit from the rounded total.
round_money and money round half to even to 0.01 and render amounts as two-decimal strings, from exact fractions of the input decimals.
validations: tier 1 boundary at up_to inclusive over the 2000 dispute replays
cross-meter account positions on multi-meter replays
calendar-month standing proration on partial periods
equal-part allowance sharing with surplus left unused
half-to-even rounding of line amounts, subtotal, credit and total
commitment credit applied only when the subtotal reaches the commitment
